name: Deck of Cards API
description: A free, public, no-auth REST API that simulates one or more decks of playing cards. Create and shuffle decks (optionally partial decks, multiple decks, or with Jokers), draw cards, organise drawn cards into named piles, and return cards to the deck. Every endpoint accepts its parameters as either GET query parameters or POST form fields; decks are identified by a deck_id and discarded after two weeks of inactivity.
